name: M5.FactorProduct.distinct_irreducibles_coprime
statement: ∀ p q : M5.BinaryPolynomial, p.Monic → q.Monic → Irreducible p → Irreducible q → p ≠ q → IsCoprime p q
guidance: Irreducible.coprime_iff_not_dvd reduces to no divisibility. A divisor of irreducible q is a unit or associated to q; irreducibility rules out the unit case. Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_associated makes associated monic p,q equal. No assumption on a cyclic modulus. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve exact target.
